title: Hyperon longitudinal polarization and vector meson spin alignment in a thermal model for heavy-ion collisions
summary: The concept of a common local spin equilibrium for both spin-1/2 and spin-1 particles is incorporated into a thermal model of particle production in heavy-ion collisions at the top RHIC energies. We show that an effective spin polarization tensor leading to a correct description of the longitudinal spin polarization of $Λ$ hyperons simultaneously yields a positive alignment of vector mesons ($φ$ and $K^{*0}$) that grows monotonically with transverse momentum and centrality.
